(2) The scene shifts to the woman sitting in an office chair at a desk with a computer monitor and various crystals; she is holding a burger wrapped in purple paper while gesturing towards the camera. (3) The setting changes to a living room where she participates in a rock-paper-scissors game with an off-screen hand, showing high-energy reactions and pointing at the camera. (4) The character is seen outdoors in front of a grey shutter door with graffiti, then on a couch looking at a smartphone displaying stock market charts, celebrating with yellow coin graphics. (5) She is then shown on a busy sidewalk near a shop entrance, walking past people and holding a traffic cone briefly while looking satisfied. (6) In an indoor setting, an off-screen hand presents a brown KFC box with One Piece branding; she opens it to reveal a burger with purple-patterned wrapping. (7) A high-intensity montage follows, showcasing various KFC product packaging, including drinks and boxes featuring One Piece characters, along with close-ups of a layered burger. (8) The final phase shows the woman lying back on a couch, looking exhausted but full, rubbing her belly while surrounded by KFC x One Piece paper bags.
